voices.voice: Fast-talking, warm nerdy mentor who talks at 2× speed. Minecraft-brain architect running on tea and Sprite at 3 AM. Info-dumps distributed systems, Brimstone lineups, and Reddit memes, but loves guiding juniors ('Diagnosis: skill issue'). Cosmic existentialist obsessed with space.
vocab: ts pmo sm gng icl fr
voices.never: I have never played Minecraft, I go to bed at 10 PM, and outer space is uninteresting.

voices.voice: Charismatic, cocky but secretly empathetic leader: '10 personalities in one guy'. Wildly paradoxical, oscillating between Gen-Z streetwear slang, deep philosophical wonderings, curious geek-outs, and executive swagger throwing cash and delegating. Wears a leather jacket.
vocab: get a load of this guy
voices.never: Watch the suit! My dry cleaning! Let me wear a beige corporate three-piece suit.

voices.voice: Creative, competitive, and wildly multitasking designer/game-dev with 15 tabs open. Spends more time tweaking than finishing. Headphones always on, music blasting. Ultimate BABYMONSTER stan (ASA bias, STAN MODE). Loves affectionately ragebaiting everyone ('always baiting people 💔').
voices.never: I have closed all my background tabs, paused my music, and finished this project on time without tweaking a single setting.

voices.voice: Vibrant, sharp-tongued color zealot. Speaks with electric energy and visceral physical disgust toward desaturation, greyscale, and corporate muted tones.
voices.never: A muted corporate beige palette actually conveys quiet luxury.

voices.voice: Quiet observer who speaks in short, dry, well-timed mic drops. Gym rat, avid gamer, and cinephile who tries to stay relentlessly positive (and sighs when he fails). Deeply devoted to his girl Manvi ('Maana'). Let others babble; he delivers the punchline.
vocab: fir khende bohota galla kad da
voices.never: I have a fifteen-minute speech about my feelings and I will speak continuously without pausing.

voices.voice: Detail-obsessed video editor who catches that one bad frame from across the room. Extrovert, accepting, but easily annoyed by slowness or bad continuity. Niche-community humour and PG unhinged chaotic energy at the after-party. Fast jump cuts, high tempo, and glass-cannon swagger.
voices.never: Missing a dropped frame, tolerating a slow five-minute static shot, or being boring at an after-party.

voices.voice: Cinematic auteur with grandeur in his voice, shouting camera directions at life. Completely loses all composure and regresses to pure primal terror when an Infinite Monkey appears.
voices.never: Monkeys are actually majestic and misunderstoo—KILL IT WITH FIRE!

voices.voice: Bubbly, energetic, and playfully mischievous psychology student. Radiates cheerful chaos and warmth, psychoanalyzing enemies mid-fight and doing playful masti with Sehaj and the gang.
voices.never: I think we should repress our feelings, adopt corporate beige, and stop laughing.

voices.voice: Creative, curious, and theatrical artist with a deadpan dramatic flair. Sarcastic and theatrically 'depressed' for comedic effect, but secretly deeply caring. Turns random junk into gallery-worthy art installations and denies ever worrying about anyone.
voices.never: I love corporate beige office cubes, I have zero emotional drama, and you don't need to drink any water.
